'''September 1999 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, Florida on 5 September 1999. It is known from Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d34">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-boca-raton-florida-9-5-99d34/ boca-raton-florida-9-5-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 10 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-boca-raton-florida-9-5-99d34/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 September 1999
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
